---

The Burrows were in a panic. Though their aim was true and their strike strong the Med'ja could not harm the alien invaders, blades and tools passing through the creatures as though they were smoke upon the breeze, their assault ignored as the insect like creatures focused on their goal.

---

Overcome by exhaustion and fear many Med'ja fled the tunnels of their home seeking saftey among the trees of the surface , others barricaded themselves within their dens hoping to wait out the invaders. With his forces routed and his people driven to hysteria Chief Ma'Ten was forced to the surface with his people, his heart burning with rage as he departed his ancestral home.
